title: Q12
description:
“Anointed You with the oil of gladness more than Your companions.”
Read: Psa 45:7, Heb 2:11–12, Heb 3:14
a) In the psalm, the companions are the king's fellows at his wedding. Hebrews later uses the same word (*partakers*, 3:14) for believers. What does the psalm's picture bring to the Son's relationship with His people?
